draw: census: all 62 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Canonical serialisation: recursive descent through the proposal artifact with all object keys sorted lexicographically, no whitespace, no trailing commas, UTF-8 encoding. The bytes of proposal_canon.json (sorted-keys JSON) are hashed with SHA-256 to produce hProposal; hProposal is then concatenated with the salt ede0431b2bc7207e0cd63a36680dea26556e7da5a0c9c7d67b6d72915eaa4e3f and hashed again with SHA-256 to produce seedHex. A third party obtains proposal_canon.json from the run's scratch directory, verifies sha256(proposal_canon.json) = 3e4f41abdfdd23819dbb5877e116e00571a5078b798e09f35cbac986c21121ae, then concatenates this hash with the salt and verifies sha256(hProposal || salt) = 8e274b4185282530739d5bf41dc0b525d9ba57450ef880d2a5c782cae19d346c. All 62 witnesses from census.json are drawn in declaration order without replacement.
